'''Keelii Mazral''' was the leader of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group [[ThunderForce]]. She was one of the oldest surviving members of the force and had led it for fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="H&S" />

==Personality and traits==
Mazral was direct and to the point. She was known as a creative and effective military leader. She was also a shrewd negotiator.<ref name="H&S" />

==Equipment==
Mazral used a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and wore a protective vest over her uniform.<ref name="H&S" />
